review.notes: Full review at an unchanged head. Previous R01 (branch pins Tau Ceti a91d3aa while the README reads 2fd255d) is not repaired; at a91d3aa 19 of the 23 cited Tau Ceti files are missing, including Cech/Colimit.lean. New P1: the Čech cup product used by §2.2, §8.2 and §8.3 has no owner, since ImplicitAtlases §6.5 gives only an external product. P3s: stale PDE 'Lane A' and HeegaardFloer F1.3 locators in §3.2; §7.1 applies the field-only Kontsevich–Manin Definition 6.1 over the ring Λ_ω; the folder clashes with #1998 and no order is stated. Gate rerun OK; depcheck 0 problems; lake env lean exits 0 with no output. All 15 seeded targets checked against KM94, KM97, Kock's psi notes and Pardon v6 at their locators; Stacks re-read. 57 Tau Ceti declarations located at 2fd255d; AnalyticStableMaps and ImplicitAtlases sections resolved at their open heads, main suppliers resolved. Adversarial table: 23 rows with computed values. Suggested.lean declares nothing, so there is no padding and no signature check to run; the docstring correctly says no headline is statable. Three source errata recorded.
